method: Decode-only diagnostic probe; selector builds only nine requested paths. One warmup, seven rotated repeats. Not a full-output CLI performance result.
limits: Exploratory decode-only probe, not a CLI speed claim. Native JSON.parse validates and materializes every field; the selector validates tokens but keeps only requested paths. Skipped strings are still tokenized. Does not establish provider/tool/duplicate-key equivalence for production use. No production dependency or parser replacement was introduced.
